says: Applied to no project, told to take a side that is neither of the two, or told to take the changes of somebody it has no word for, it is refused in a sentence that says what to say instead; and with the program not signed in, it says how to sign in.

steps.fails: so it is applied to a project: --project <project>
`prefer` is which side is taken where a ticket changed on both, `here` or `there`; it is `newest`.
`takes_in` is whose changes of an issue on GitHub are taken into its card, `everyone`, `trusted` or `nobody`; it is `friends`.
The program `gh` is not signed in on this device.
